description: Closes a timeline's TAB in the editor — hides it from the tab row, does NOT delete it: it stays in the media pool, and you (or anyone) can still edit, verify, nest and export it. When it was the one shown, the editor shows the next open tab, or none.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: close_timeline
title: Close timeline tab
